items.question: What exactly is ElyraLab and how does it work?
items.answer: ElyraLab is an AI-powered creative workflow platform. It supports natural language text-to-image generation, text + image editing, multi-image composition, iterative refinements, and high-fidelity text rendering, giving you precise control over every revision.

items.question: How do I edit existing visuals with ElyraLab?
items.answer: Upload a base image, describe the changes you need, and ElyraLab applies additions, removals, and style shifts without masks. You can keep iterating conversationally until the scene matches your vision, and every output ships with a SynthID watermark for provenance.

items.question: Which projects benefit most from ElyraLab?
items.answer: Use ElyraLab for portrait retouching, product photography, cinematic storytelling, UGC campaigns, and brand-safe typography. ElyraLab's multimodal understanding blends elements from multiple inputs and keeps backgrounds intact even under heavy edits.

items.question: Can I control output size and aspect ratio?
items.answer: Yes. Specify aspect ratios such as 1:1, 16:9, or 9:16 to match your channel requirements, and the engine renders the corresponding resolution automatically so you can ship pixel-perfect assets without manual cropping.

items.question: How do I craft effective prompts for ElyraLab?
items.answer: Start with the subject and setting, add mood or lighting cues, then specify the level of detail or camera style you want. You can reference colors, outfits, materials, or even upload guide images to steer composition and keep characters consistent with ElyraLab.

items.question: Can l use ElyraLab outputs for commercial projects?
items.answer: Yes. Ensure you have rights to any reference assets, double-check brand guidelines, and remember that every ElyraLab output carries a SynthID watermark to help document provenance when you launch campaigns.
